title: hook and action refusals: the save door's code and reason readers stop at the closing quote, so `code: 'OVER' + suffix` is refused at save as code 'OVER'
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8yeqbR9TKANdPKRxt

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding of PR #36666 (#35698), reported by its dev (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`, report comment 7098411542). Source: fleet.
Seam: spec:hookRefusalCodesThrownIn / hookRefusalReasonsThrownIn → runtime: HookSchema and ActionSchema refusal refinements (`hook.zod.ts`, `action.zod.ts`)
reach: public door, the HookSchema save refinement (ActionSchema.refusals uses the same one), measured with `HookSchema.safeParse` at dc8f1abe.

## What happens
- `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts` reads the refusal codes and reasons a hook or action body throws with four readers: `CODE_PROPERTY`, `CODE_ASSIGNMENT`, `REASON_PROPERTY`, `REASON_ASSIGNMENT`. Each ends at the closing quote of the literal.
- So `throw { code: 'OVER' + suffix }` is read as a literal throw of code `OVER`. A hook declaring `refusals: { OVER_LIMIT }` whose body is `const suffix = '_LIMIT'; throw { code: 'OVER' + suffix };` is refused at `body.source` as throwing an undeclared code `OVER`. The reason readers do the same (`reason: 'too' + suffix` reads as `too`).
- Contract text this breaks, the `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn` docblock: "A code that arrives any other way — a helper's parameter, a variable, a computed value — is left to the run-time refusal."

## Ask
- Each of the four readers treats a code or reason as literal only when the literal ends the value (the terminators its form allows: `,` or `}` for a property; `;`, a line end, `}` or `)` for an assignment). A computed value is left to the run-time refusal, as the docblock says.
- Pins: a plain literal still refused when undeclared, and a concatenated one not refused at save, for code and reason, property and assignment, on hooks and actions.
- ⛔ Not a new rule. Same family as #35698 (the text-key reader, fixed in PR #36666 with a lookahead after the closing quote); this card covers the four remaining readers in that file.

## Re-check
`grep -n "^const CODE_PROPERTY\|^const CODE_ASSIGNMENT\|^const REASON_PROPERTY\|^const REASON_ASSIGNMENT" packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusal-codes.ts`, then read whether each pattern ends at its closing quote.

Dedupe: searched open issues for `CODE_PROPERTY concatenation` (1 hit, #35698), `refusal code computed save` (8 hits, none this defect), `hookRefusalCodesThrownIn literal` (1, #35698), `REASON_ASSIGNMENT closing quote` (1, #35698).

Suggested-grade: p2 · the grade of its sibling #35698 (a false save refusal on a computed value) · suggested domain `domain:spec` · area:build · for triage first touch.
